sha256-dos-manifest-v1:4755df7b13b14abac.title: J-Bird
sha256-dos-manifest-v1:4755df7b13b14abac.description: J-Bird is a conversion of the arcade game Q*Bert. The object of the game is to change all tiles in a pyramid to the target color by having J-Bird jump on the tile. Various creatures and objects can get in the way of J-Bird. These include a bouncing snake, cats, falling balls, and frogs. There are four rounds per level, and each level increases in difficulty by having more enemies onscreen and requiring more complicated rules for a tile to reach the target color (For example, on the second level you need to jump on each tile twice.) On the sides of the pyramid are platforms which J-Bird can jump onto to evade the snake. If the snake is close enough to the platform when J-Bird jumps on, the snake will fall off the edge.

sha256-dos-manifest-v1:47f2eb6598a945a2c.title: Power Struggle
sha256-dos-manifest-v1:47f2eb6598a945a2c.description:
Power Struggle allows you to compete against a friend or the computer for World domination as either the West or the East. After choosing your side you are presented with a map of the World. The countries belonging to the West are in green, the countries belonging to the East are red and neutral countries are white. Your aim is to take over as many countries as you can while your opponent is doing the same.

You are presented with icons and within a time limit must decide how to take over countries, these options are attack, supply, apply political influence or build factories and armies. Once you have both made your choices the orders are executed. Although you can take over countries your opponent can take yours over and vice versa so holding on to them is part of the challenge as well.

sha256-dos-manifest-v1:47b86d24c2e704dbe.title: Bionic Police
sha256-dos-manifest-v1:47b86d24c2e704dbe.description: The game itself, though rather monotonous, but complex and unusual. So, we play for a certain incomprehensible human-like warrior with a big gun and powerful hands (it’s not just said so about them). Despite the formidable appearance, he will instantly die from any contact with enemies and any hostile objects, whether it be enemy ammunition or something else (this is also not just said so); or rather, it will die , apparently - for a second it will disappear, and then be reborn. There are really many “lives” in the game.

sha256-dos-manifest-v1:470e2a30a728b9b81.title: Kquest
sha256-dos-manifest-v1:470e2a30a728b9b81.description: You start this game in your hotel room, and the aim is to collect an ill-assorted swag of treasures around and outside the local town, and deposit them in the Bank. The climate and geography surrounding this little town varies amazingly, from snow-covered mountains outside the west end of town, to dense jungle at the east end. There's also an abandoned mine to explore, and some coastal scenery to the south, where a sunken ship lies somewhere under the sea.

sha256-dos-manifest-v1:4768b41cb2e21a63d.title: Into the Eagle's Nest
sha256-dos-manifest-v1:4768b41cb2e21a63d.description: Pandora's first game combines the Gauntlet style with the World War 2 setting, and specifically the Eagle's Nest building which is being used by a commander as his HQ. Three Allied soldiers have been captured, and you must infiltrate the facilities, rescue your brave comrades, destroy the building, and salvage as much of the stolen art treasures as possible.There are eight levels to explore, each with a specific mission objective. Some of the paintings are loose, others are in crates which must first be shot. Explosives must be collected, not shot. With limited ammunition, guards everywhere, keys at a premium, and lots of strategic hiding points, an all-guns-blazing approach is less successful than a planned, measured one.

sha256-dos-manifest-v1:4755b379312e7efc4.title: Silent Operation III: The Impossible Mission Under Water
sha256-dos-manifest-v1:4755b379312e7efc4.description: A space based horizontal shoot em' up with the standard assortment of weapon powerups.

sha256-dos-manifest-v1:4702bce96a15054b2.title: Mutan Zone
sha256-dos-manifest-v1:4702bce96a15054b2.description: Scorpio was one of the most beautiful space colonies of all the galaxy and its raw materials were one of the fundamental points of the terrestrial wealth. But, one day, the explosion of a Supernova altered the genes of the inhabitants of the planet, turning them into strange beings who hate the human specie and want to destroy it. In such a situation, the Earth space services sent a series of scientists in order to study the mutation and the way for solving it. But they were captured and forced to work for the scorpians in the creation of a definitive weapon that would make disappear our planet of the Solar System. Only a Rainbow-Command could avoid it and your help will be indispensable for the attainment of the mission.The game is composed of two parts, within which there are two introduction sub-games that will allow you to obtain some additional lives before starting the game itself. On the first part you will have to face a series of natural obstacles while shooting to everything with strange looks, for that, you count with a laser and a cosmic hammer, but you also should take batteries for your portable radar that informs to you of the enemy situation. Once finished this part, you will start the last one, in which you must be careful in not crashing your newly-acquired motorcycle with the multiple obstacles you will find, at the same time you get rid of the mutants, whereas you go to the laboratory where you will have to liberate the kidnapped scientists.  It won't be easy - you will find the head of the mutants who is anxious to give you a warm welcome.

sha256-dos-manifest-v1:47fe22ce5d39d2396.title: Destetroyer
sha256-dos-manifest-v1:47fe22ce5d39d2396.description: Tetris on a futuristic (mostly, but not only) theme, where each level has a certain conditional plot rationale (say, fill a spacecraft with energy), an unusual (and always different) design of figures that fall from above (forget about the “boring” blocks and get ready for the most real pretzels!), and indeed a very original and beautiful level decoration.

sha256-dos-manifest-v1:47a7d6ade51626d25.title: Focsy
sha256-dos-manifest-v1:47a7d6ade51626d25.description: A rare Spanish arcade game, which even has extremely limited fame even in its homeland and is informally referred to as " Ecco the Dolphin for the poor." Apparently, there is no specific plot - you have to play for the white seal, swimming underwater, fighting (if you can call it that) with enemies, collect bonuses and move on.

sha256-dos-manifest-v1:477e3fc058ccc8ff8.title: 4th & Inches
sha256-dos-manifest-v1:477e3fc058ccc8ff8.description: 4th & Inches is an action/strategy football game for one or two players. You control the action during the variety of plays that can be called, choose when to take timeouts, and select which players on your team will be on the field. There are two teams (the All-Pros and the Champs) and you can see each players statistics to determine how fast or strong he will be.

sha256-dos-manifest-v1:4711a9ace1ee35b07.title: Grand Prix Master
sha256-dos-manifest-v1:4711a9ace1ee35b07.description:
A motorcycle racing game recreating the now-defunct 80cc world motorcycle racing championship. It was licensed around Spanish ace Jorge Martinez 'Aspar', and your (and his) racing rivals including future 500cc World Champion Alex Criville.

The game features a full practice mode as well as qualifying and races. There are only 8 computer bikes, although the real life championship points system is used, meaning that the penalty for not finishing is bigger than in real life, especially as you only have 5 bikes to last the season. The game is viewed from overhead, and the controls are, unusually, direction based, so to take a straight which (in the overhead view) involves going up and to the right, you must push the joystick in that direction.

sha256-dos-manifest-v1:47ead2d2e288efe94.title: Terradyne
sha256-dos-manifest-v1:47ead2d2e288efe94.description: Welcome to the Terradyne World. The Terradyne RPG is a game that was written in response to the overall poor quality of the majority of role playing games on the market. I was always disappointed when a good role playing game would come to an end.  Why couldn't someone make a game so that you could add-on modules and campaigns along with all sorts of medieval weapons and fantastic magic?  This would allow you to continiously upgrade and improve the game while still providing new adventures and artifacts for the players to conquer and destroy.  This is my attempt in the design of fantasy role playing game for this type of unending supply of material for the gamer.  Terradyne was written for a 286,386 or higher class machine with at least EGA.

sha256-dos-manifest-v1:4717fffaac04de268.title: Aspetra
sha256-dos-manifest-v1:4717fffaac04de268.description: Aspetra is mainly the work of Andy Wood, who wrote his first RPG, The Endless Night, in 1993, when he was fifteen. Some of the level and monster design was done by Andy's younger brother Peter. The game was originally shareware, when sales tapered off, they released it for free.

sha256-dos-manifest-v1:473c092da41acb88c.title: CRASH
sha256-dos-manifest-v1:473c092da41acb88c.description:
Crash is a Tron-like game distributed according to the freeware (for the DOS version) and shareware concepts (for the Windows version).

Depending on these versions, human players can be up to two (DOS) or four (Windows), against up to ten (DOS & Windows) computer-controlled players.

The year is 2234 and the government invented crash races to control the people, according to the story of this game. Futuristic cars are equipped with rockets and turbos and all you have to do is to stay alive until the end of the race, since there will be only one winner, that will take all the money offered by the United Planet Federation (UPF).

sha256-dos-manifest-v1:472103b3bfeaf8bbd.title: Field General
sha256-dos-manifest-v1:472103b3bfeaf8bbd.description:
Field General is an American Pro Football game for one or two players.

The game is entirely keyboard controlled. The player(s) name their teams and can either direct all elements of the play themselves or they can opt to have the teams play automatically.

This game is not a management game, there's no player's draft, no financial juggling, none of that sort of stuff. The key, and allegedly unique, feature of this game is that both teams start off equal and it is the player(s) ability in calling the plays that decides who is victorious.

sha256-dos-manifest-v1:47cccd78d7ed193fa.title: Bundesliga Manager Professional
sha256-dos-manifest-v1:47cccd78d7ed193fa.description:
Your favorite soccer team is in the third class, has no money and no future? Take the job as a manager and lead your team in the first division.

Bundesliga Manager Professional is a managerial simulator of soccer. The game simulates the German Bundesliga (first, second and third division) and the German league cup (DFB-Pokal). The teams and players has real names (season 1990).

Up to 4 players can take part. You can transfer players, rise your stadium, deal for advertising, train your players. The tactics of your team can be set very individual on a small playing field. Also included are match graphics with 3D-animated goal chances.

Other features:
36 different injuries
Newspaper reports after every match
5 different skills

Bundesliga Manager Professional is the second installment in the series.
tags: Construction and Management Simulation; Sports / Soccer

sha256-dos-manifest-v1:47f2f8c53e85bae53.title: Ant Man
sha256-dos-manifest-v1:47f2f8c53e85bae53.description: A bright, dynamic and extremely easy to master platform arcade from the Republic of Korea. The game is based on the adventures of superheroes, dressed in high-tech suits, reminiscent of ... ants. It is very likely that such an artistic decision could not but arise in the comic culture. Quite a close Taiwan equivalent to this strange biological phenomenon (human ant) is no less strange lizard man, whose comical adventures are shown in the game L-Man , published in 1996 in Chinese. And in Ant Man - as always in the best traditions of Korean developers - the quality of graphics, music, and most gameplay itself are brought to the fore.

sha256-dos-manifest-v1:4745c0f84e5c6bdcd.title: Origamo
sha256-dos-manifest-v1:4745c0f84e5c6bdcd.description:
In the game you have to exit the maze filled with mythological characters of 5 different philosophies (Japanese/Chinese, Tribal, Egyptian, Indian, European) with the Orb of Time. To acquire it you have to take some item in one room and to bring it to another room to get next one, and so on to the Orb of Time. In each room of the maze you must solve the puzzle, where the main gameplay flows.

You have to put the tiles in the place to fill the entire figures of different sorts. Seven types of tiles are convex combinations of the right-angled triangles. The tiles are moved to you on the belt of conveyor. To successfully finish the level you may dump the unnecessary tiles (up to 50) which do not fit in the places and take the limited space on the conveyor belt. Placing the tiles in all places of specific types will clear the conveyor belt. Time is counting and allows you to make the best time on the level. Completing each puzzle successfully will give you the fixed amount of money and unsuccessfully will take this amount from you. These amounts may show you how difficult the puzzle is and how fast the conveyor belt will move.

Logging in the game with certain name you begin your career. There are four modes of gameplay: Basic, Master, Random, and Adventure. In Adventure Mode you have 3 lives at start and may gain another ones by scoring 500 points while in other modes you have infinite number of lives. Different difficulty levels allows you to score standard, more (+25%), or less (-25%) amount of points. Highscores are also showing the best of the best.

sha256-dos-manifest-v1:475d1c50b7b96ada4.title: Princess Maker 2
sha256-dos-manifest-v1:475d1c50b7b96ada4.description:
A hero saved the human race from utter annihilation by the gods. This same hero then was charged by the heavens to take care of young seed dropped from there. This seed becomes his daughter, and her guardian will be watching her progress.

In Princess Maker 2 the player assumes the role of a father to the blessed daughter of the heavens. For the next eight years, the hero will nurture and guide her in the path of the player's own choosing.

It is possible to choose the path of the zodiac-influenced daughter by scheduling her to jobs and schools, which will raise her statistics (strength, combat skills, cooking, faith, etc.) Each month allows the player to designate three different tasks for her to follow. Balancing between character development, stress level, health and financial income is the focus of this game.

Mini sub-quests and various plot options revolve around  the young lady adventuring in the wilderness, provided that she's strong enough to tame the wilds. The player can equip her with armor and weapons to fight off wandering random monsters in turn-based combat.

The game starts with the daughter at age ten, from which point the player guides her until her adult years. Choices made during the course of the game will determine her eventual marital status, accomplishments and her relationships with other people. There are 74 unique endings in the game.

sha256-dos-manifest-v1:47709dea6d74d0456.title: The Smurfs
sha256-dos-manifest-v1:47709dea6d74d0456.description: Free the Smurfs before Gargamel smurfs then all! Platform game where you will be able to play with the jockey smurf, the brainy smurf, the greedy smurf and the hefty smurf to resolve the adventure. All of the classic SMURF characters are along for the adventure, guaranteeing you a Smurf-tastic time.

sha256-dos-manifest-v1:47f1caa485b8ad7ca.title: UEFA Champions League
sha256-dos-manifest-v1:47f1caa485b8ad7ca.description: A fully licensed soccer game, featuring all 16 teams that played the Champion's League in 94 and all the real players of that time. The perspective is isometric, the control over the players during the match is complete, while the managerial or coaching elements are minimalistic. Various camera positions are available for better observation of the match. At the moment when the ball is with the opposing team, you can control only the player who is closest to the ball. It is impossible to change the composition of clubs - that is, there is no transfers of players in the game at all. The controls are not very responsive and the AI is extremely low - often the opposite team’s players try to take the ball away from you only if they are very close to you. Coupled with even lower intelligence goalkeepers (who move only if the player moves with the ball, approaching the goal), the game becomes sometimes too simple, and sometimes - on the contrary, artificially complicated.

sha256-dos-manifest-v1:4734023c382ddba5a.title: Wooden Ships & Iron Men
sha256-dos-manifest-v1:4734023c382ddba5a.description:
Wooden Ships & Iron Men is a turn-based game that allows you to recreate naval battles from the 18th and 19th centuries, based upon the successful boardgame by Avalon Hill.

You may choose from a list of scenarios or play a campaign. Choosing the Scenario option allows to select a series of set battles from the American Revolutionary War, the French Revolutionary War, the Napoleonic Wars or the War of 1812, where you will have the choice of commanding American, British or French ships. In campaign mode, you take command of a selection of US ships during the War of 1812, where your task is to sink as many British ships as possible during your career.

Ships are controlled with the mouse, enabling you to change course, load cannons, reassign your crew to stations and grapple. The game allows for a computer opponent, a human opponent or play by e-mail.

A Scenario Editor is also available, allowing you to create your own missions.

sha256-dos-manifest-v1:471dc985ed56aeb92.title: Race Mania
sha256-dos-manifest-v1:471dc985ed56aeb92.description:
Race Mania brings you fast and furious 3D action racing. In this racing game there is no such thing as fair play. Bump and smash your opponent racers off the track.

Up to 8 human players can join the racing action. Split-screen mode for 2 players is possible. It includes 20 exciting tracks and 10 different cars.

Racing management: You can buy and sell cars and repair them. Create your own tracks with an included track editor. Create own racing leagues or choose one from the ten existing ones. Choose your style of play: Peaceful, Normal or Brutal.

sha256-dos-manifest-v1:4731bfc72bcb1681a.title: Pinball Wizard 2000
sha256-dos-manifest-v1:4731bfc72bcb1681a.description: Pinball Wizard 2000 from Ikarion Software GmbH is the successor of Kingsoft's Pinball Wizard for the Amiga. This pinball game features five tables (Themes: Industrial Revolution, Hattrick, Rock'n'Roll Heaven, Prohibition, Earth Inferno) and one bonus table (Mystic).PW2000 is more of an action-oriented game instead of a real simulation since the physics are somewhat strange at times. But the real strength of the program is the implemented Pinball Construction Set. All tables were built with this construction set and with the detailed instruction manual and samples everyone with some programming knowledge can do some amazing tables on his own.

sha256-dos-manifest-v1:4756cff652cc61681.title: System Shock
sha256-dos-manifest-v1:4756cff652cc61681.description:
System Shock is a first-person shooter with puzzle-solving and light role-playing elements. The gameplay incorporates gradual exploration of the Citadel's ten levels, interaction with the environment, problem-solving, fulfilling objectives, and combat.

On his way the hacker encounters numerous enemies - robots, cyborgs and mutants, all of which can be fought back with a variety of weapons. Some of the weapons use ammo, while other have infinite ammo and instead draw on electric energy. Some weapons are more effective on certain foes - e.g. the dart gun only works on organic enemies, while the magpulse is best used against robots. Once killed, the enemies can be searched for ammo and other items. The player can also find items in crates, cabinets, corpses or just lying around on the ground.

Apart from weapons and ammo, the player can find patches (such as medical patches, which replenish the hero's health; berserk patches, which temporarily increase his strength but cause hallucinations; detox patches, which remove the harmful effects of radiation and biohazard; etc.), grenades of various kinds (EMP grenades are effective against robots, gas grenades are good for mutants, land mines can be used to set traps, etc.), battery packs for replenishing electricity, first aid kits for restoring health, and others.

sha256-dos-manifest-v1:477aad30c07d7258a.title: Circle of Blood
sha256-dos-manifest-v1:477aad30c07d7258a.description:
George Stobbart is an American tourist spending his autumn vacation in Paris. He barely escapes a bombing of a café and decides to investigate the clues left behind by the killer. This eventually leads him to a mystery dating back to the legend of the Knights Templar.

Circle of Blood is the first part in the Broken Sword series. It is a third-person puzzle-solving point-and-click adventure game with 2D cartoon-like graphics. The player moves the character around using the mouse, examines the environment, talks to other people and collects items stored in an inventory. These items need to be used or combined with other items to solve puzzles. George gets help from Nicole Collard, a French journalist. The story is divided into eleven chapters and takes place in locations such as Paris, Ireland, Syria, and others.
